summary: Assess retirement-income risks, test assumptions, and document response controls. Explore the five-day intermediate course.
lede: Risk management in retirement planning helps professionals assess threats to retirement income and document practical controls. For pension advisers, retirement-benefit analysts and wealth planners, the course develops skills to map income dependencies, compare cash-flow and market scenarios in Excel, and distinguish inherent from residual risk. Participants also practise setting withdrawal review triggers, assigning owners and recording response choices; advanced stochastic modelling is introduced at an operational level.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course suits professionals who assess retirement income risks, review pension arrangements, or prepare advice and oversight records. It is designed for roles that need to translate changing assumptions into documented controls and decisions.
modules: Retirement Risk Register and Exposure Mapping
Withdrawal Policy Limits and Review Triggers
Excel Retirement Risk Dashboard and Reporting
prerequisites: Working knowledge of retirement-income planning, pension or investment arrangements, and basic spreadsheet use. No coding is required. Bring a laptop with Excel installed; the exercises use supplied worksheets and illustrative case data.
